clauses.reason: The order amends Executive Order 12503 by changing the commission’s name in the title and section 1(a) to President’s Commission on Americans Outdoors and by restating section 4(b) so that the Commission submits its report no later than 1986-12-31 and "shall terminate 30 days after its report". Executive Order 12610 of September 30, 1987 states in its section 3 that the listed Executive Orders, which established committees that have terminated or whose work is completed, are revoked, and the list includes "(e) Executive Order No. 12503, as amended by Executive Order No. 12529," establishing the President’s Commission on Americans Outdoors. That is an express revocation that names this order as the amendment of EO 12503. Its section 5 states "Sec. 5. This Order shall be effective September 30,1987." The report deadline of 1986-12-31 and the 30-day report-relative termination are spent facts and not ends under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21; the actual report date is not held. EO 12610 recites that the listed committees have terminated or completed their work, without a date, which is disclosed.

research_rationale:
EO 12529 (signed 1985-08-14; 50 FR 33329) was read in full in the held Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12529.txt. It renames the commission created by Executive Order 12503 and restates its section 4(b) (report no later than 1986-12-31, termination 30 days after its report). The dossier evidence ACT:EO:12529>EO:12610 was re-read against the held EO 12610 text (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12610.txt): section 3(e) revokes EO 12503 "as amended by Executive Order No. 12529", section 5 gives the express effective date 1987-09-30. Machine searches read: U.S. Code 0 hits, eCFR 0 hits, Federal Register catalog 0 hits. The LOOKUPS number search finds EO 12610 and the order itself as texts citing EO 12529. Under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on report deadlines the report date is a deadline and the report-relative termination is a spent fact, not an end; the express revocation is the end.
